AI BIJAN Motion - packed source files of this folder. Do not edit by hand.
The skill upload in the Claude app accepts at most 200 files, so the source files are packed here.
`node <skill folder>/new-project.mjs <project folder> --kit=<style>` unpacks them into the project.
Format: per file one line with four '=' signs, the byte length and the path, then exactly that many bytes.

==== 33612 project/src/cine/neural/Brain.tsx
// The neural world (a metaphor, not a scan): a glass brain with sulci, a neuron network carrying
// signals, hero neurons for macro shots, the optic-fibre tunnel, the prediction core with its two
// streams (information = cyan, experience = orange), the pareidolia point cloud and the socket face.
// Brain-local units: the cerebrum spans z −1…1.

import React, { useLayoutEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  AdditiveBlending,
  BufferGeometry,
  CatmullRomCurve3,
  Color,
  DoubleSide,
  Float32BufferAttribute,
  IcosahedronGeometry,
  Line,
  LineBasicMaterial,
  LineSegments,
  Mesh,
  MeshBasicMaterial,
  Points,
  ShaderMaterial,
  TubeGeometry,
  Vector3,
} from "three";
import { mergeVertices } from "three/examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js";
import { FX_LAYER } from "../../core/render/Post.tsx";
import { ease, remap } from "../../core/motion/easing.ts";
import { cached, cyl, sphere, torus, box } from "../../kits/worldforge/geo.ts";
import { mulberry32 } from "../../kits/worldforge/noise.ts";
import { canvasTex, phys } from "../mats.ts";
import { planeG } from "./plane.ts";
import { HUMAN, resample, inside, type Poly } from "./silhouettes.ts";
import { BLUE, CYAN, glowMat, noise3, ORANGE, pointsMat } from "./glow.ts";

const fx = (o: { layers: { set: (n: number) => void } } | null) => o?.layers.set(FX_LAYER);

// ── brain shell ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const ridged = (x: number, y: number, z: number) => {
  const wx = x + 0.6 * noise3(x * 0.7 + 3, y * 0.7, z * 0.7);
  const wz = z + 0.6 * noise3(x * 0.7, y * 0.7 + 5, z * 0.7);
  const a = 1 - Math.abs(2 * noise3(wx, y, wz) - 1);
  const b = 1 - Math.abs(2 * noise3(wx * 2.1 + 9, y * 2.1, wz * 2.1) - 1);
  return Math.pow(a, 1.6) * 0.72 + b * 0.28;
};

export const brainGeo = () =>
  cached("brainShell", () => {
    let g: BufferGeometry = new IcosahedronGeometry(1, 6);
    g.deleteAttribute("normal");
    g.deleteAttribute("uv");
    g = mergeVertices(g);
    const a = g.attributes.position;
    const fold = new Float32Array(a.count);
    for (let i = 0; i < a.count; i++) {
      const v = new Vector3(a.getX(i), a.getY(i), a.getZ(i));
      const p = new Vector3(v.x * 0.8, v.y * 0.68, v.z * 1.0);
      // longitudinal fissure between the hemispheres
      const fis = Math.exp(-((v.x / 0.09) ** 2)) * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (v.y + 0.25) * 1.6));
      p.y -= 0.1 * fis;
      p.x *= 1 + 0.04 * fis;
      // flatter base, temporal lobes, narrower occipital
      if (p.y < -0.2) p.y = -0.2 + (p.y + 0.2) * 0.55;
      const temp = Math.exp(-(((Math.abs(v.x) - 0.85) / 0.25) ** 2) - ((v.y + 0.35) / 0.3) ** 2 - ((v.z - 0.15) / 0.45) ** 2);
      p.x += Math.sign(v.x) * 0.06 * temp;
      p.y -= 0.05 * temp;
      if (v.z < -0.3) p.x *= 1 - 0.1 * (-0.3 - v.z);
      const f = ridged(v.x * 4.2, v.y * 4.2, v.z * 4.2);
      fold[i] = f;
      const n = p.clone().normalize();
      p.addScaledVector(n, (f - 0.55) * 0.055 * (1 - 0.7 * fis));
      a.setXYZ(i, p.x, p.y, p.z);
    }
    g.setAttribute("fold", new Float32BufferAttribute(fold, 1));
    g.computeVertexNormals();
    return g;
  });

const cerebellumGeo = () =>
  cached("cerebellum", () => {
    let g: BufferGeometry = new IcosahedronGeometry(1, 4);
    g.deleteAttribute("normal");
    g.deleteAttribute("uv");
    g = mergeVertices(g);
    const a = g.attributes.position;
    const fold = new Float32Array(a.count);
    for (let i = 0; i < a.count; i++) {
      const v = new Vector3(a.getX(i), a.getY(i), a.getZ(i));
      const f = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(v.y * 34 + v.z * 6);
      fold[i] = f;
      const p = new Vector3(v.x * 0.5, v.y * 0.24, v.z * 0.3).addScaledVector(v, (f - 0.5) * 0.015);
      a.setXYZ(i, p.x, p.y, p.z);
    }
    g.setAttribute("fold", new Float32BufferAttribute(fold, 1));
    g.computeVertexNormals();
    return g;
  });

const shellMat = () =>
  new ShaderMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    depthWrite: false,
    blending: AdditiveBlending,
    side: DoubleSide,
    fog: false,
    uniforms: {
      uCyan: { value: new Color(CYAN) },
      uOrange: { value: new Color(ORANGE) },
      uTime: { value: 0 },
      uOpacity: { value: 1 },
      uOrangeAmt: { value: 1 },
    },
    vertexShader: /* glsl */ `attribute float fold; varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV; varying float vFold; varying vec3 vP;
      void main(){ vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); vN = normalize(normalMatrix * normal); vV = normalize(-mv.xyz); vFold = fold; vP = position; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv; }`,
    fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `uniform vec3 uCyan; uniform vec3 uOrange; uniform float uTime; uniform float uOpacity; uniform float uOrangeAmt;
      varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV; varying float vFold; varying vec3 vP;
      void main(){
        float f = clamp(1.0 - abs(dot(normalize(vN), normalize(vV))), 0.0, 1.0);
        float rim = f * f;
        float sulc = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.08, 0.42, vFold);
        float crest = smoothstep(0.72, 1.0, vFold);
        vec3 c = uCyan * (0.02 + 0.5 * rim + 0.1 * crest) + vec3(0.2, 0.5, 1.0) * 0.025;
        float wave = sin(vP.z * 6.0 - uTime * 2.2 + sin(vP.x * 5.0 + vP.y * 3.0) * 1.7);
        c += uOrange * smoothstep(0.86, 1.0, wave) * sulc * uOrangeAmt * 1.2;
        c += uCyan * sulc * 0.06;
        gl_FragColor = vec4(c * uOpacity, 1.0);
      }`,
  });

export const BrainShell: React.FC<{ t: number; opacity?: number; orange?: number }> = ({ t, opacity = 1, orange = 1 }) => {
  const m = useMemo(shellMat, []);
  const m2 = useMemo(shellMat, []);
  m.uniforms.uTime.value = t;
  m.uniforms.uOpacity.value = opacity;
  m.uniforms.uOrangeAmt.value = orange;
  m2.uniforms.uTime.value = t + 3;
  m2.uniforms.uOpacity.value = opacity * 0.8;
  m2.uniforms.uOrangeAmt.value = orange * 0.5;
  const stem = useMemo(() => glowMat({ color: CYAN, rim: 0.8, core: 0.05 }), []);
  (stem.uniforms.uOpacity as { value: number }).value = opacity;
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh geometry={brainGeo()} material={m} ref={fx} renderOrder={5} />
      <mesh geometry={cerebellumGeo()} material={m2} position={[0, -0.36, -0.72]} ref={fx} renderOrder={5} />
      <mesh geometry={cyl(0.1, 0.07, 0.55, 20, true)} material={stem} position={[0, -0.55, -0.35]} rotation={[0.35, 0, 0]} ref={fx} renderOrder={5} />
    </group>
  );
};

// ── neuron network ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type Net = { pts: Vector3[]; edges: [number, number][] };
export const makeNet = (seed: number, n: number, accept: (p: Vector3) => boolean, rng: () => Vector3, k = 2): Net => {
  const r = mulberry32(seed);
  const pts: Vector3[] = [];
  let guard = 0;
  while (pts.length < n && guard++ < n * 50) {
    const p = rng();
    if (accept(p)) pts.push(p);
  }
  const edges: [number, number][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
    const d = pts.map((q, j) => [q.distanceToSquared(pts[i]), j] as const).sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
    for (let m = 1; m <= k; m++) if (d[m] && (r() < 0.9 || m === 1)) edges.push([i, d[m][1]]);
  }
  return { pts, edges };
};

const inBrain = (p: Vector3) => (p.x / 0.74) ** 2 + ((p.y + 0.03) / 0.58) ** 2 + (p.z / 0.93) ** 2 < 1 && p.y > -0.42;

export const brainNet = (n = 760) =>
  cached(`brainNet${n}`, () => {
    const r = mulberry32(17);
    const net = makeNet(9, n, inBrain, () => new Vector3(r() * 2 - 1, r() * 2 - 1, r() * 2 - 1));
    const g = new BufferGeometry();
    g.userData.net = net;
    return g;
  });

/** Somas + connections + travelling signals. `pulse` scales signal traffic, `tint` 0 cyan … 1 orange share. */
export const Network: React.FC<{ net: Net; t: number; opacity?: number; pulse?: number; orangeShare?: number; size?: number; seed?: number }> = ({ net, t, opacity = 1, pulse = 1, orangeShare = 0.25, size = 0.028, seed = 1 }) => {
  const objs = useMemo(() => {
    const somaG = new BufferGeometry();
    const sp: number[] = [], sc: number[] = [];
    const r = mulberry32(seed);
    const cy = new Color(CYAN), bl = new Color(BLUE), or = new Color(ORANGE);
    for (const p of net.pts) {
      sp.push(p.x, p.y, p.z);
      const c = r() < 0.12 ? or.clone() : cy.clone().lerp(bl, r() * 0.6);
      c.multiplyScalar(0.6 + r() * 0.6);
      sc.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
    }
    somaG.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(sp, 3));
    somaG.setAttribute("color", new Float32BufferAttribute(sc, 3));
    const lineG = new BufferGeometry();
    const lp: number[] = [], lc: number[] = [];
    for (const [a, b] of net.edges) {
      const A = net.pts[a], B = net.pts[b];
      lp.push(A.x, A.y, A.z, B.x, B.y, B.z);
      const k = 0.25 + r() * 0.35;
      lc.push(0.25 * k, 0.75 * k, 1.0 * k, 0.25 * k, 0.75 * k, 1.0 * k);
    }
    lineG.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(lp, 3));
    lineG.setAttribute("color", new Float32BufferAttribute(lc, 3));
    const lineM = new LineBasicMaterial({ vertexColors: true, transparent: true, opacity: 0.5, blending: AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, fog: false });
    const P = 260;
    const pulses = Array.from({ length: P }, () => ({ e: Math.floor(r() * net.edges.length), sp: 0.4 + r() * 1.1, ph: r(), orange: r() }));
    const pulseG = new BufferGeometry();
    pulseG.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(P * 3), 3));
    pulseG.setAttribute("color", new Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(P * 3), 3));
    return { somaG, lineG, lineM, pulses, pulseG, somaM: pointsMat(size * 2.2), pulseM: pointsMat(size * 2.6) };
  }, [net, seed, size]);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const pos = objs.pulseG.attributes.position as Float32BufferAttribute;
    const col = objs.pulseG.attributes.color as Float32BufferAttribute;
    const cy = new Color(CYAN), or = new Color(ORANGE);
    objs.pulses.forEach((q, i) => {
      const u = (t * q.sp + q.ph) % 1;
      const [a, b] = net.edges[(q.e + Math.floor(t * q.sp + q.ph) * 7) % net.edges.length];
      const A = net.pts[a], B = net.pts[b];
      pos.setXYZ(i, A.x + (B.x - A.x) * u, A.y + (B.y - A.y) * u, A.z + (B.z - A.z) * u);
      const c = q.orange < orangeShare ? or : cy;
      const k = Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * pulse * 1.6;
      col.setXYZ(i, c.r * k, c.g * k, c.b * k);
    });
    pos.needsUpdate = true;
    col.needsUpdate = true;
    objs.somaM.opacity = opacity;
    objs.pulseM.opacity = opacity;
    objs.lineM.opacity = 0.45 * opacity;
  });
  return (
    <group>
      <lineSegments geometry={objs.lineG} material={objs.lineM} ref={fx} renderOrder={4} />
      <points geometry={objs.somaG} material={objs.somaM} ref={fx} renderOrder={6} />
      <points geometry={objs.pulseG} material={objs.pulseM} ref={fx} renderOrder={7} frustumCulled={false} />
    </group>
  );
};

// ── hero neurons (macro) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

const neuronGeo = (seed: number) =>
  cached(`neuron${seed}`, () => {
    const r = mulberry32(seed);
    const tubes: BufferGeometry[] = [];
    const branch = (o: Vector3, dir: Vector3, len: number, rad: number, depth: number) => {
      const pts = [o.clone()];
      let p = o.clone(), d = dir.clone();
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        d.add(new Vector3(r() - 0.5, r() - 0.5, r() - 0.5).multiplyScalar(0.7)).normalize();
        p = p.clone().addScaledVector(d, len / 5);
        pts.push(p);
      }
      const curve = new CatmullRomCurve3(pts);
      const tg = new TubeGeometry(curve, 24, rad, 6, false);
      // taper
      const a = tg.attributes.position;
      for (let i = 0; i < a.count; i++) {
        const seg = Math.floor(i / 7) / 24;
        const c = curve.getPoint(Math.min(1, seg));
        const v = new Vector3(a.getX(i), a.getY(i), a.getZ(i)).sub(c).multiplyScalar(1 - 0.7 * seg).add(c);
        a.setXYZ(i, v.x, v.y, v.z);
      }
      tubes.push(tg);
      if (depth > 0) for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) branch(p, d.clone().add(new Vector3(r() - 0.5, r() - 0.5, r() - 0.5)).normalize(), len * 0.62, rad * 0.6, depth - 1);
    };
    for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
      const d = new Vector3(r() - 0.5, r() - 0.5, r() - 0.5).normalize();
      branch(d.clone().multiplyScalar(0.12), d, 0.55 + r() * 0.3, 0.03, 2);
    }
    branch(new Vector3(0, -0.1, 0), new Vector3(0.2, -1, 0.3).normalize(), 1.6, 0.035, 0);
    const parts = tubes.map((g) => { g.deleteAttribute("uv"); return g.index ? g.toNonIndexed() : g; });
    const merged = new BufferGeometry();
    let total = 0;
    for (const p of parts) total += p.attributes.position.count;
    const pos = new Float32Array(total * 3), nor = new Float32Array(total * 3);
    let off = 0;
    for (const p of parts) {
      pos.set(p.attributes.position.array as Float32Array, off * 3);
      nor.set(p.attributes.normal.array as Float32Array, off * 3);
      off += p.attributes.position.count;
    }
    merged.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
    merged.setAttribute("normal", new Float32BufferAttribute(nor, 3));
    return merged;
  });

export const HeroNeuron: React.FC<{ seed: number; p: [number, number, number]; s: number; color?: string; t: number; opacity?: number }> = ({ seed, p, s, color = CYAN, t, opacity = 1 }) => {
  const m = useMemo(() => glowMat({ color, rim: 0.9, core: 0.1, power: 1.6 }), [color]);
  const soma = useMemo(() => glowMat({ color: "#ffffff", rim: 0.8, core: 0.35, power: 1.4 }), []);
  const halo = useMemo(() => glowMat({ color, rim: 0.0, core: 0.2, power: 1 }), [color]);
  const beat = 0.75 + 0.25 * Math.sin(t * 2.4 + seed);
  (m.uniforms.uOpacity as { value: number }).value = opacity;
  (soma.uniforms.uOpacity as { value: number }).value = opacity * beat;
  (halo.uniforms.uOpacity as { value: number }).value = opacity * 0.25 * beat;
  return (
    <group position={p} scale={s}>
      <mesh geometry={neuronGeo(seed)} material={m} ref={fx} renderOrder={6} />
      <mesh geometry={sphere(0.13, 24, 16)} material={soma} ref={fx} renderOrder={7} />
      <mesh geometry={sphere(0.3, 24, 16)} material={halo} ref={fx} renderOrder={7} />
    </group>
  );
};

// ── optic tunnel ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const tunnelGeo = () =>
  cached("tunnel", () => {
    const r = mulberry32(31);
    const pos: number[] = [], col: number[] = [];
    for (let f = 0; f < 220; f++) {
      const r0 = 0.18 + r() * 0.32, a0 = r() * Math.PI * 2, tw = 0.6 + r() * 0.6;
      const k = 0.4 + r() * 0.6;
      let prev: Vector3 | null = null;
      for (let i = 0; i <= 60; i++) {
        const z = 1.4 + (i / 60) * 5.5;
        const rr = r0 * (0.65 + 0.35 * Math.min(1, (z - 1.4) / 2.5));
        const a = a0 + z * tw;
        const p = new Vector3(Math.cos(a) * rr, Math.sin(a) * rr, z);
        if (prev) {
          pos.push(prev.x, prev.y, prev.z, p.x, p.y, p.z);
          const c = r() < 0.15 ? [1, 0.6, 0.24] : [0.37, 0.89, 1];
          col.push(c[0] * k, c[1] * k, c[2] * k, c[0] * k, c[1] * k, c[2] * k);
        }
        prev = p;
      }
    }
    const g = new BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
    g.setAttribute("color", new Float32BufferAttribute(col, 3));
    return g;
  });

const OpticTunnel: React.FC<{ t: number; opacity: number }> = ({ t, opacity }) => {
  const m = useMemo(() => new LineBasicMaterial({ vertexColors: true, transparent: true, blending: AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, fog: false }), []);
  m.opacity = opacity;
  const streaks = useMemo(() => {
    const r = mulberry32(5);
    const g = new BufferGeometry();
    const n = 300;
    g.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(n * 3), 3));
    const c = new Float32Array(n * 3);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const o = r() < 0.2; c.set(o ? [1, 0.6, 0.25] : [0.5, 0.92, 1], i * 3); }
    g.setAttribute("color", new Float32BufferAttribute(c, 3));
    return { g, seeds: Array.from({ length: n }, () => [r() * Math.PI * 2, 0.05 + r() * 0.45, r(), 0.6 + r()]), m: pointsMat(0.035) };
  }, []);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const a = streaks.g.attributes.position as Float32BufferAttribute;
    streaks.seeds.forEach(([ang, rr, ph, sp], i) => {
      const z = 6.9 - (((t * sp * 2.2 + ph) % 1) * 5.5);
      a.setXYZ(i, Math.cos(ang + z) * rr, Math.sin(ang + z) * rr, z);
    });
    a.needsUpdate = true;
    streaks.m.opacity = opacity;
  });
  return (
    <group>
      <lineSegments geometry={tunnelGeo()} material={m} ref={fx} renderOrder={4} />
      <points geometry={streaks.g} material={streaks.m} ref={fx} frustumCulled={false} renderOrder={6} />
    </group>
  );
};

// ── photo card (the "camera" idea that the brain does not follow) ──────────

const photoTex = () =>
  canvasTex("photo", 512, 640, (g, w, h) => {
    g.fillStyle = "#a9a396";
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    const x0 = 28, y0 = 28, W = w - 56, H = h - 150;
    const gr = g.createLinearGradient(0, y0, 0, y0 + H);
    gr.addColorStop(0, "#152034");
    gr.addColorStop(1, "#0a0f18");
    g.fillStyle = gr;
    g.fillRect(x0, y0, W, H);
    g.strokeStyle = "rgba(120,150,200,0.35)";
    g.lineWidth = 2;
    const vx = x0 + W * 0.55, vy = y0 + H * 0.45;
    for (const [ax, ay] of [[x0, y0], [x0 + W, y0], [x0, y0 + H], [x0 + W, y0 + H]]) { g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(ax, ay); g.lineTo(vx + (ax - vx) * 0.2, vy + (ay - vy) * 0.2); g.stroke(); }
    g.fillStyle = "#7d9fd8";
    g.fillRect(vx - 40, vy - 70, 80, 95);
    g.fillStyle = "#04060a";
    g.beginPath(); g.arc(vx, vy - 52, 13, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();
    g.fillRect(vx - 22, vy - 38, 44, 92);
    g.fillRect(vx - 12, vy + 54, 9, 22); g.fillRect(vx + 3, vy + 54, 9, 22);
    g.fillStyle = "#3a3f47";
    g.font = "600 30px Manrope, sans-serif";
    g.textAlign = "center";
    g.fillText("02:01", w / 2, h - 62);
  });

// ── pareidolia point cloud ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** The coat stand as the eye actually received it: helmet, coat, sleeves, tote, pole, boots. */
const standPoints = () =>
  cached("standPts", () => {
    const r = mulberry32(77);
    const inStand = (x: number, y: number) =>
      Math.hypot(x - 0.0, y - 0.9) < 0.085 ||
      (y > 0.32 && y < 0.82 && Math.abs(x) < 0.17 + (0.82 - y) * 0.05 && !(y > 0.78 && Math.abs(x) > 0.12)) ||
      (y > 0.48 && y < 0.8 && Math.abs(Math.abs(x) - 0.2) < 0.035) ||
      (x < -0.18 && x > -0.27 && y > 0.4 && y < 0.62) ||
      (Math.abs(x) < 0.012 && y > 0.12 && y < 0.34) ||
      (y < 0.13 && Math.abs(Math.abs(x) - 0.05) < 0.035);
    const pos: number[] = [], col: number[] = [], home: number[] = [];
    while (pos.length < 2200 * 3) {
      const x = r() - 0.5, y = r() * 1.02;
      if (!inStand(x, y)) continue;
      const z = (r() - 0.5) * 0.12;
      pos.push(x, y, z);
      home.push(x, y, z);
      const k = 0.9 + r() * 0.8;
      col.push(1.0 * k, 0.95 * k, 0.85 * k);
    }
    const g = new BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
    g.setAttribute("color", new Float32BufferAttribute(col, 3));
    g.userData.home = home;
    return g;
  });

const lineFrom = (poly: Poly, z = 0.02) => {
  const g = new BufferGeometry();
  const pts = resample(poly, 220);
  g.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(pts.flatMap(([x, y]) => [x, y, z]), 3));
  return g;
};

export const PatternCloud: React.FC<{ t: number; t0: number }> = ({ t, t0 }) => {
  const pts = standPoints();
  const m = useMemo(() => pointsMat(0.026), []);
  const lineG = useMemo(() => lineFrom(HUMAN), []);
  const lineM = useMemo(() => new LineBasicMaterial({ color: ORANGE, transparent: true, blending: AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, fog: false }), []);
  const glowG = useMemo(() => {
    const g = new BufferGeometry();
    const p = resample(HUMAN, 90);
    g.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(p.flatMap(([x, y]) => [x, y, 0.02]), 3));
    g.setAttribute("color", new Float32BufferAttribute(p.flatMap(() => [1, 0.55, 0.2]), 3));
    return g;
  }, []);
  const glowM = useMemo(() => pointsMat(0.03), []);
  const u = t - t0;
  // points flicker into view blurry (0..1.2), the outline is drawn (2.7..3.4), holds, then flickers out (4.4..5.2)
  const appear = ease.out(remap(u, 0, 1.2));
  const draw = ease.inOut(remap(u, 2.6, 3.5));
  const flick = u > 4.35 && u < 4.75 ? (Math.floor(u * 22) % 2 ? 0.25 : 1) : 1;
  const out = 1 - ease.inOut(remap(u, 4.7, 5.25));
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const a = pts.attributes.position as Float32BufferAttribute;
    const home = pts.userData.home as number[];
    const jit = 0.06 * (1 - ease.out(remap(u, 0, 2.4)));
    for (let i = 0; i < a.count; i++) {
      const s = Math.sin(i * 12.9898 + t * 3.1) * 0.5;
      a.setXYZ(i, home[i * 3] + s * jit, home[i * 3 + 1] + Math.cos(i * 4.1 + t * 2.3) * 0.5 * jit, home[i * 3 + 2]);
    }
    a.needsUpdate = true;
    m.opacity = appear * (0.75 + 0.25 * Math.sin(t * 9));
    lineG.setDrawRange(0, Math.floor(220 * draw));
    lineM.opacity = draw * flick * out;
    glowM.opacity = draw * flick * out * 0.9;
  });
  return (
    <group>
      <points geometry={pts} material={m} ref={fx} frustumCulled={false} renderOrder={6} />
      <primitive object={useMemo(() => new Line(lineG, lineM), [lineG, lineM])} ref={fx} renderOrder={8} />
      <points geometry={glowG} material={glowM} ref={fx} renderOrder={8} />
    </group>
  );
};

/** Wall socket with a face drawn over it. */
export const SocketFace: React.FC<{ t: number; t0: number }> = ({ t, t0 }) => {
  const u = t - t0;
  const ring = useMemo(() => {
    const mk = (cx: number, cy: number, r: number, a0 = 0, a1 = Math.PI * 2, n = 48) => {
      const g = new BufferGeometry();
      const p: number[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) { const a = a0 + ((a1 - a0) * i) / n; p.push(cx + Math.cos(a) * r, cy + Math.sin(a) * r, 0.09); }
      g.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(p, 3));
      return g;
    };
    return [mk(-0.06, 0.02, 0.042), mk(0.06, 0.02, 0.042), mk(0, -0.02, 0.105, Math.PI * 1.22, Math.PI * 1.78)];
  }, []);
  const lm = useMemo(() => new LineBasicMaterial({ color: ORANGE, transparent: true, blending: AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, fog: false }), []);
  const draw = ease.inOut(remap(u, 0.5, 1.3));
  lm.opacity = draw;
  ring.forEach((g) => g.setDrawRange(0, Math.floor(49 * draw)));
  const plate = phys("bigPlate", { color: "#8f99a4", roughness: 0.45, clearcoat: 0.4 });
  const holeM = phys("bigHole", { color: "#0d0f12", roughness: 0.9 });
  const lines = useMemo(() => ring.map((g) => new Line(g, lm)), [ring, lm]);
  return (
    <group rotation={[0, 0.25 * (1 - ease.out(remap(u, 0, 2.4))), 0]}>
      <mesh geometry={box(0.5, 0.5, 0.06, 0.04)} material={plate} castShadow />
      <mesh geometry={cyl(0.17, 0.17, 0.05, 48)} material={phys("bigRecess", { color: "#d9dde1", roughness: 0.5 })} position={[0, 0, 0.03]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
      {[-0.06, 0.06].map((x) => (
        <mesh key={x} geometry={cyl(0.022, 0.022, 0.06, 20)} material={holeM} position={[x, 0.02, 0.04]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
      ))}
      <mesh geometry={box(0.08, 0.012, 0.02, 0.004)} material={phys("ground", { color: "#a9adb2", metalness: 0.9, roughness: 0.3 })} position={[0, -0.1, 0.06]} />
      {lines.map((l, i) => <primitive key={i} object={l} ref={fx} renderOrder={8} />)}
    </group>
  );
};

// ── backdrop ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const NeuralBackdrop: React.FC<{ top: string; bottom: string; glow: string; r?: number }> = ({ top, bottom, glow, r = 140 }) => {
  const m = useMemo(
    () =>
      new ShaderMaterial({
        side: 1, depthWrite: false, fog: false,
        uniforms: { uTop: { value: new Color(top) }, uBot: { value: new Color(bottom) }, uGlow: { value: new Color(glow) } },
        vertexShader: /* glsl */ `varying vec3 vD; void main(){ vD = normalize(position); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
        fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `uniform vec3 uTop; uniform vec3 uBot; uniform vec3 uGlow; varying vec3 vD;
          float h(vec3 p){ return fract(sin(dot(p, vec3(12.9898,78.233,37.719))) * 43758.5453); }
          void main(){ vec3 d = normalize(vD); vec3 c = mix(uBot, uTop, d.y * 0.5 + 0.5);
            c += uGlow * pow(max(0.0, 1.0 - length(d.xy - vec2(0.0, 0.05))), 3.0) * 0.35 * smoothstep(-0.2, 0.6, d.z);
            gl_FragColor = vec4(c, 1.0); }`,
      }),
    [top, bottom, glow],
  );
  (m.uniforms.uTop.value as Color).set(top);
  (m.uniforms.uBot.value as Color).set(bottom);
  (m.uniforms.uGlow.value as Color).set(glow);
  return <mesh geometry={sphere(r, 32, 16)} material={m} renderOrder={-10} />;
};

/** Dust motes of light drifting in the neural space. */
export const Motes: React.FC<{ t: number; n?: number; R?: number; opacity?: number }> = ({ t, n = 500, R = 4, opacity = 1 }) => {
  const o = useMemo(() => {
    const r = mulberry32(55);
    const g = new BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(n * 3), 3));
    const c = new Float32Array(n * 3);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const k = 0.2 + r() * 0.5; const orn = r() < 0.15; c.set(orn ? [k, 0.55 * k, 0.2 * k] : [0.4 * k, 0.8 * k, k], i * 3); }
    g.setAttribute("color", new Float32BufferAttribute(c, 3));
    return { g, s: Array.from({ length: n }, () => [r() * 2 - 1, r() * 2 - 1, r() * 2 - 1, r() * 6]), m: pointsMat(0.02 * R) };
  }, [n, R]);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const a = o.g.attributes.position as Float32BufferAttribute;
    o.s.forEach(([x, y, z, ph], i) => a.setXYZ(i, (x + Math.sin(t * 0.21 + ph) * 0.05) * R, (y + ((t * 0.02 + ph) % 2) * 0.05) * R, (z + Math.cos(t * 0.17 + ph) * 0.05) * R));
    a.needsUpdate = true;
    o.m.opacity = opacity;
  });
  return <points geometry={o.g} material={o.m} ref={fx} frustumCulled={false} renderOrder={3} />;
};

// ── streams into the prediction core ───────────────────────────────────────

export const Stream: React.FC<{ curve: CatmullRomCurve3; color: string; t: number; on: number; n?: number; thin?: boolean }> = ({ curve, color, t, on, n = 90, thin }) => {
  const tube = useMemo(() => new TubeGeometry(curve, 80, thin ? 0.004 : 0.012, 6, false), [curve, thin]);
  const tm = useMemo(() => glowMat({ color, rim: 1.2, core: 0.25 }), [color]);
  (tm.uniforms.uOpacity as { value: number }).value = on * 0.8;
  const o = useMemo(() => {
    const g = new BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(n * 3), 3));
    const c = new Color(color);
    g.setAttribute("color", new Float32BufferAttribute(Array.from({ length: n }, () => [c.r * 1.5, c.g * 1.5, c.b * 1.5]).flat(), 3));
    return { g, m: pointsMat(thin ? 0.022 : 0.05) };
  }, [n, color, thin]);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const a = o.g.attributes.position as Float32BufferAttribute;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const u = ((i / n) + t * 0.32) % 1;
      const p = curve.getPoint(u);
      a.setXYZ(i, p.x + Math.sin(i * 7.3) * 0.02, p.y + Math.cos(i * 3.1) * 0.02, p.z);
    }
    a.needsUpdate = true;
    o.m.opacity = on;
  });
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh geometry={tube} material={tm} ref={fx} renderOrder={6} />
      <points geometry={o.g} material={o.m} ref={fx} frustumCulled={false} renderOrder={7} />
    </group>
  );
};

export const CORE: [number, number, number] = [0, 0.06, -0.15];
const INFO_CURVE = new CatmullRomCurve3([new Vector3(0.05, 0.12, 1.25), new Vector3(0.25, 0.2, 0.7), new Vector3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2), new Vector3(...CORE)]);
const EXP_CURVE = new CatmullRomCurve3([new Vector3(-0.42, -0.32, -0.55), new Vector3(-0.35, -0.15, -0.2), new Vector3(-0.15, 0.0, -0.1), new Vector3(...CORE)]);

const PredictionCore: React.FC<{ t: number; on: number; info: number; exp: number }> = ({ t, on, info, exp }) => {
  const m = useMemo(() => glowMat({ color: "#ffd9a8", rim: 0.9, core: 0.55, power: 1.5 }), []);
  const h = useMemo(() => glowMat({ color: ORANGE, rim: 0, core: 0.3, power: 1 }), []);
  const ringM = useMemo(() => glowMat({ color: CYAN, rim: 1, core: 0.6 }), []);
  const beat = 0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(t * 5.2) + 0.25 * info * exp;
  (m.uniforms.uOpacity as { value: number }).value = on * beat;
  (h.uniforms.uOpacity as { value: number }).value = on * 0.22 * beat;
  (ringM.uniforms.uOpacity as { value: number }).value = on * 0.6;
  return (
    <group>
      <group position={CORE}>
        <mesh geometry={sphere(0.06, 32, 20)} material={m} ref={fx} renderOrder={8} />
        <mesh geometry={sphere(0.17, 32, 20)} material={h} ref={fx} renderOrder={8} />
        <mesh geometry={torus(0.12, 0.003, 6, 64)} material={ringM} rotation={[Math.PI / 2 + Math.sin(t) * 0.3, t * 0.7, 0]} ref={fx} renderOrder={8} />
        <mesh geometry={torus(0.15, 0.002, 6, 64)} material={ringM} rotation={[0.4, -t * 0.5, 0.3]} ref={fx} renderOrder={8} />
      </group>
      <Stream curve={INFO_CURVE} color={CYAN} t={t} on={info} />
      <Stream curve={EXP_CURVE} color={ORANGE} t={t * 0.8 + 0.3} on={exp} />
    </group>
  );
};

// ── the whole neural set for scene 5 ───────────────────────────────────────

export const BrainSet: React.FC<{ t: number }> = ({ t }) => {
  const net = brainNet().userData.net as Net;
  const tunnel = 1 - ease.inOut(remap(t, 34.3, 35.0));
  const photoIn = ease.out(remap(t, 35.5, 36.1));
  const photoGone = ease.inOut(remap(t, 36.6, 37.5));
  // dimmer while the camera is inside it, and behind the pattern / socket close-ups
  const shell = ease.inOut(remap(t, 33.6, 34.8)) * (1 - 0.72 * ease.inOut(remap(t, 37.2, 37.9)) + 0.1 * ease.inOut(remap(t, 42.8, 43.6)));
  const info = ease.inOut(remap(t, 37.9, 38.8));
  const heroOn = ease.inOut(remap(t, 36.5, 37.3)) * (1 - ease.inOut(remap(t, 42.7, 43.3)));
  const exp = ease.inOut(remap(t, 39.8, 40.6));
  const photo = useMemo(() => phys("photoCard", { map: photoTex(), roughness: 0.5, emissive: "#ffffff", emissiveMap: photoTex(), emissiveIntensity: 0.08, transparent: true }), []);
  photo.opacity = photoIn * (1 - photoGone);
  return (
    <group>
      <NeuralBackdrop top="#0f3b66" bottom="#06162b" glow="#3aa6e8" r={60} />
      <Motes t={t} R={4} />
      {t < 35.2 ? <OpticTunnel t={t} opacity={tunnel} /> : null}
      <BrainShell t={t} opacity={shell} orange={t > 38 ? 1.2 : 0.6} />
      <Network net={net} t={t} opacity={Math.min(1, shell * 1.3) * (t > 42.9 ? 0.55 : 1)} pulse={1 + info + exp} orangeShare={0.2 + 0.25 * exp} />
      {t > 36.5 && t < 43.4 ? (
        <>
          <HeroNeuron seed={3} p={[0.62, 0.34, 0.18]} s={0.3} t={t} opacity={heroOn} />
          <HeroNeuron seed={7} p={[-0.32, 0.05, 0.25]} s={0.28} color={ORANGE} t={t} opacity={heroOn} />
          <HeroNeuron seed={11} p={[0.2, -0.18, -0.35]} s={0.3} t={t} opacity={heroOn} />
          <PredictionCore t={t} on={ease.inOut(remap(t, 37.0, 37.8)) * (1 - ease.inOut(remap(t, 42.8, 43.3)))} info={info} exp={exp} />
        </>
      ) : null}
      {photo.opacity > 0.01 ? (
        <mesh geometry={planeG(0.3, 0.37)} material={photo} position={[0.45 - photoGone * 0.3, 0.25 - photoGone * 0.12, 2.2 - photoGone * 0.8]} rotation={[0.02, 0.25 + photoGone * 0.2, 0.05]} />
      ) : null}
      {t > 36.6 && t < 37.8 ? <PhotoDust t={t} /> : null}
      {t > 42.9 && t < 48.4 ? (
        <group position={[0, -0.32, 1.55]} scale={0.6}>
          <PatternCloud t={t} t0={43.0} />
        </group>
      ) : null}
      {t > 48.2 ? (
        <group position={[0, 0.0, 1.62]} scale={0.55}>
          <SocketFace t={t} t0={48.4} />
        </group>
      ) : null}
    </group>
  );
};

const PhotoDust: React.FC<{ t: number }> = ({ t }) => {
  const o = useMemo(() => {
    const r = mulberry32(91);
    const n = 600;
    const g = new BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(n * 3), 3));
    const c: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const w = r() < 0.5; c.push(w ? 0.9 : 0.4, w ? 0.9 : 0.75, 1); }
    g.setAttribute("color", new Float32BufferAttribute(c, 3));
    return { g, s: Array.from({ length: n }, () => [r() - 0.5, r() - 0.5, r(), r()]), m: pointsMat(0.012) };
  }, []);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const u = ease.inOut(remap(t, 36.6, 37.8));
    const a = o.g.attributes.position as Float32BufferAttribute;
    o.s.forEach(([x, y, d, w], i) => {
      const k = Math.min(1, u * (1 + w));
      a.setXYZ(i, 0.45 + x * 0.3 * (1 - k * 0.8) - k * 0.4, 0.25 + y * 0.37 * (1 - k * 0.8) - k * 0.2, 2.2 - k * (1.2 + d * 0.7));
    });
    a.needsUpdate = true;
    o.m.opacity = 1 - ease.in(remap(t, 37.3, 37.8));
  });
  return <points geometry={o.g} material={o.m} ref={fx} frustumCulled={false} renderOrder={8} />;
};

==== 3122 project/src/cine/neural/glow.ts
// Additive "light" materials for the neural world: fresnel glow shells, soft point sprites, 3D noise.

import { AdditiveBlending, CanvasTexture, Color, DoubleSide, PointsMaterial, ShaderMaterial, type Side } from "three";

const h3 = (x: number, y: number, z: number) => {
  let n = Math.sin(x * 127.1 + y * 311.7 + z * 74.7) * 43758.5453;
  return n - Math.floor(n);
};
const sm = (t: number) => t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
/** Smooth 3D value noise in 0..1. */
export const noise3 = (x: number, y: number, z: number) => {
  const xi = Math.floor(x), yi = Math.floor(y), zi = Math.floor(z);
  const xf = sm(x - xi), yf = sm(y - yi), zf = sm(z - zi);
  const l = (a: number, b: number, t: number) => a + (b - a) * t;
  const c = (dx: number, dy: number, dz: number) => h3(xi + dx, yi + dy, zi + dz);
  return l(
    l(l(c(0, 0, 0), c(1, 0, 0), xf), l(c(0, 1, 0), c(1, 1, 0), xf), yf),
    l(l(c(0, 0, 1), c(1, 0, 1), xf), l(c(0, 1, 1), c(1, 1, 1), xf), yf),
    zf,
  );
};

export type GlowOpts = { color: string; rim?: number; core?: number; power?: number; side?: Side; opacity?: number };

/** Fresnel glow (additive): bright silhouettes, faint faces. Uniform `uOpacity` fades it. */
export const glowMat = (o: GlowOpts) =>
  new ShaderMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    depthWrite: false,
    blending: AdditiveBlending,
    side: o.side ?? DoubleSide,
    fog: false,
    uniforms: {
      uColor: { value: new Color(o.color) },
      uRim: { value: o.rim ?? 1.0 },
      uCore: { value: o.core ?? 0.15 },
      uPow: { value: o.power ?? 2.0 },
      uOpacity: { value: o.opacity ?? 1 },
    },
    vertexShader: /* glsl */ `varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV;
      void main(){ vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); vN = normalize(normalMatrix * normal); vV = normalize(-mv.xyz); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv; }`,
    fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `uniform vec3 uColor; uniform float uRim; uniform float uCore; uniform float uPow; uniform float uOpacity;
      varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV;
      void main(){ float f = clamp(1.0 - abs(dot(normalize(vN), normalize(vV))), 0.0, 1.0);
        float g = uCore + uRim * pow(f, uPow);
        gl_FragColor = vec4(uColor * g * uOpacity, 1.0); }`,
  });

let sprite: CanvasTexture | null = null;
/** Soft round sprite for points (never square). */
export const spriteTex = () => {
  if (sprite) return sprite;
  const c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = c.height = 64;
  const g = c.getContext("2d")!;
  const gr = g.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 0, 32, 32, 32);
  gr.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,1)");
  gr.addColorStop(0.25, "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)");
  gr.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
  g.fillStyle = gr;
  g.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
  sprite = new CanvasTexture(c);
  return sprite;
};

export const pointsMat = (size: number, opacity = 1) =>
  new PointsMaterial({
    size, map: spriteTex(), vertexColors: true, transparent: true, opacity, depthWrite: false, blending: AdditiveBlending, sizeAttenuation: true, fog: false,
  });

export const CYAN = "#5fe3ff";
export const ORANGE = "#ff9a3d";
export const BLUE = "#2f7bff";

==== 4889 project/src/cine/neural/silhouettes.ts
// 2D silhouettes shared by the memory shadows, the expectation templates and the ending ghosts.
// Drawn on canvases (alpha masks, white on transparent) and as polylines in a unit box
// (x −0.5…0.5, y 0…1, y up), so the same shape can be a shadow, a glowing outline or points.

import { canvasTex } from "../mats.ts";

export type Poly = [number, number][];

/** Human standing figure outline (the "pattern" the brain completes). */

  [0.2, 0.44], [0.19, 0.62], [0.16, 0.55], [0.15, 0.3], [0.13, 0.02], [0.03, 0.02], [0.02, 0.3], [0, 0.4], [-0.02, 0.3], [-0.03, 0.02],

  [-0.06, 0.81], [-0.05, 0.835], [-0.09, 0.87], [-0.1, 0.93], [-0.07, 0.985], [0, 1.0],

/** Pocong: a wrapped shroud tied above the head and at the feet. */

/** Haunted house: crooked roof, a broken shutter, a dead tree. */
export const RUMAH: Poly = [
  [-0.5, 0.0], [-0.5, 0.42], [-0.56, 0.42], [-0.2, 0.78], [-0.16, 0.74], [-0.12, 0.9], [-0.05, 0.9], [-0.05, 0.82], [0.12, 0.98],
  [0.52, 0.5], [0.44, 0.5], [0.46, 0.0], [-0.5, 0.0],

const drawPoly = (g: CanvasRenderingContext2D, poly: Poly, w: number, h: number, pad = 0.06) => {
  const s = Math.min(w, h) * (1 - pad * 2);
  g.beginPath();
  poly.forEach(([x, y], i) => {
    const px = w / 2 + x * s, py = h - (pad * h + y * s);
    if (i === 0) g.moveTo(px, py);
    else g.lineTo(px, py);
  });
  g.closePath();
};

/** Soft-edged white mask of a silhouette (for shadows on walls and dissolving ghosts). */
export const silhouetteTex = (key: string, poly: Poly, extra?: (g: CanvasRenderingContext2D, w: number, h: number) => void) =>
  canvasTex(`sil${key}`, 512, 512, (g, w, h) => {
    g.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    g.filter = "blur(6px)";
    g.fillStyle = "#fff";
    drawPoly(g, poly, w, h);
    g.fill();
    if (extra) extra(g, w, h);
    g.filter = "none";
  });

export const KUNTI_TEX = () =>
  silhouetteTex("kunti", KUNTI, (g, w, h) => {
    // hair strands falling past the shoulders
    g.strokeStyle = "#fff";
    g.lineWidth = 6;
    for (let i = -3; i <= 3; i++) {
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(w / 2 + i * 9, h * 0.1);
      g.bezierCurveTo(w / 2 + i * 14, h * 0.3, w / 2 + i * 22, h * 0.42, w / 2 + i * 18, h * 0.58);
      g.stroke();
    }
  });
export const POCONG_TEX = () => silhouetteTex("pocong", POCONG);
export const RUMAH_TEX = () =>
  silhouetteTex("rumah", RUMAH, (g, w, h) => {
    // windows cut out like eyes
    g.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-out";
    g.fillStyle = "#000";
    g.fillRect(w * 0.3, h * 0.55, w * 0.1, h * 0.12);
    g.fillRect(w * 0.58, h * 0.5, w * 0.1, h * 0.15);
    g.fillRect(w * 0.45, h * 0.78, w * 0.1, h * 0.16);
    g.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
  });
export const HUMAN_TEX = () => silhouetteTex("human", HUMAN);

/** Resample a closed polyline to n evenly spaced points. */
export const resample = (poly: Poly, n: number): Poly => {
  const seg: number[] = [];
  let L = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < poly.length - 1; i++) {
    const d = Math.hypot(poly[i + 1][0] - poly[i][0], poly[i + 1][1] - poly[i][1]);
    seg.push(d);
    L += d;
  }
  const out: Poly = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    let s = (k / (n - 1)) * L, i = 0;
    while (i < seg.length - 1 && s > seg[i]) { s -= seg[i]; i++; }
    const f = seg[i] > 0 ? Math.min(1, s / seg[i]) : 0;
    out.push([poly[i][0] + (poly[i + 1][0] - poly[i][0]) * f, poly[i][1] + (poly[i + 1][1] - poly[i][1]) * f]);
  }
  return out;
};

/** Even-odd point-in-polygon test. */
export const inside = (poly: Poly, x: number, y: number) => {
  let c = false;
  for (let i = 0, j = poly.length - 1; i < poly.length; j = i++) {
    const [xi, yi] = poly[i], [xj, yj] = poly[j];
    if (yi > y !== yj > y && x < ((xj - xi) * (y - yi)) / (yj - yi) + xi) c = !c;
  }
  return c;
};

==== 7846 project/src/cine/Post.tsx
// CINÉSTORY camera + finishing chain: MSAA → NaN guard → GTAO → bokeh DOF → bloom → PBR Neutral tone
// map → film grade (lift/gain, saturation, contrast, landscape vignette, lens chromatic fringe, grain,
// flash, fade to black). The grade is driven per shot and blends across lamp changes and transitions.

import React, { useLayoutEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { useFrame, useThree } from "@react-three/fiber";
import { Color, HalfFloatType, NeutralToneMapping, PerspectiveCamera, Vector2, Vector3, WebGLRenderTarget } from "three";
import { EffectComposer } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js";
import { RenderPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/RenderPass.js";
import { GTAOPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/GTAOPass.js";
import { BokehPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/BokehPass.js";
import { UnrealBloomPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js";
import { OutputPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/OutputPass.js";
import { ShaderPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/ShaderPass.js";
import { FX_LAYER, withoutFx } from "../core/render/Post.tsx";
import { mixC } from "./Lights.tsx";

import { GRADE0, type Cam, type Grade } from "./types.ts";
export { GRADE0, type Cam, type Grade };

export const CameraRig: React.FC<{ cam: Cam }> = ({ cam }) => {
  const { camera } = useThree();
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const c = camera as PerspectiveCamera;
    c.position.set(...cam.pos);
    const f = new Vector3(...cam.target).sub(c.position).normalize();
    const r = cam.roll ?? 0;
    // roll about the view axis
    const up = new Vector3(0, 1, 0);
    const side = new Vector3().crossVectors(f, up).normalize();
    const u2 = new Vector3().crossVectors(side, f).normalize();
    c.up.copy(u2.multiplyScalar(Math.cos(r)).addScaledVector(side, Math.sin(r)));
    c.lookAt(...cam.target);
    c.fov = cam.fov;
    c.near = cam.near ?? 0.05;
    c.far = cam.far ?? 900;
    c.updateProjectionMatrix();
    c.updateMatrixWorld();
    c.layers.enable(FX_LAYER);
  }, [cam, camera]);
  return null;
};

const NanGuardShader = {
  uniforms: { tDiffuse: { value: null } },
  vertexShader: /* glsl */ `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `uniform sampler2D tDiffuse; varying vec2 vUv;
    void main(){ vec4 c = texture2D(tDiffuse, vUv);
      if (any(isnan(c)) || any(isinf(c))) c = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
      gl_FragColor = clamp(c, 0.0, 64.0); }`,
};

const GradeShader = {
  uniforms: {
    tDiffuse: { value: null },
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uRes: { value: new Vector2(1920, 1080) },
    uCA: { value: 0.0012 },
    uLift: { value: new Vector3() },
    uGain: { value: new Vector3(1, 1, 1) },
    uSat: { value: 1 },
    uContrast: { value: 1 },
    uVignette: { value: 0.2 },
    uGrain: { value: 0.015 },
    uFlash: { value: 0 },
    uFlashColor: { value: new Color("#fff") },
    uBlack: { value: 0 },
  },
  vertexShader: /* glsl */ `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `
    uniform sampler2D tDiffuse; uniform float uTime; uniform vec2 uRes;
    uniform vec3 uLift; uniform vec3 uGain; uniform float uSat; uniform float uContrast;
    uniform float uVignette; uniform float uGrain; uniform float uFlash; uniform vec3 uFlashColor; uniform float uBlack; uniform float uCA;
    varying vec2 vUv;
    float hash(vec2 p){ p = fract(p * vec2(443.897, 441.423)); p += dot(p, p.yx + 19.19); return fract((p.x + p.y) * p.x); }
    void main(){
      vec2 cd = vUv - 0.5;
      float ca = uCA * dot(cd, cd) * 4.0;
      vec3 c = vec3(texture2D(tDiffuse, vUv - cd * ca).r, texture2D(tDiffuse, vUv).g, texture2D(tDiffuse, vUv + cd * ca).b);
      vec3 x = clamp(c, 0.0, 1.0);
      x = x * uGain + uLift * (1.0 - x);
      float l = dot(x, vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
      x = mix(vec3(l), x, uSat);
      x = clamp((x - 0.5) * uContrast + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0);
      x = mix(x, x * x * (3.0 - 2.0 * x), 0.18);
      vec2 d = (vUv - 0.5) * vec2(1.0, 0.86);
      x *= 1.0 - uVignette * smoothstep(0.28, 0.82, length(d));
      float g = hash(vUv * uRes + uTime * 17.0) - 0.5;
      x += g * uGrain * (0.5 + 0.5 * (1.0 - l));
      x = mix(x, uFlashColor, clamp(uFlash, 0.0, 1.0));
      x *= 1.0 - clamp(uBlack, 0.0, 1.0);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(x, 1.0);
    }`,
};

export const FilmPost: React.FC<{ cam: Cam; grade: Grade; frame: number }> = ({ cam, grade, frame }) => {
  const { gl, scene, camera, size } = useThree();
  const chain = useMemo(() => {
    const w = size.width, h = size.height;
    const rt = new WebGLRenderTarget(w, h, { type: HalfFloatType, samples: 4 });
    const composer = new EffectComposer(gl, rt);
    composer.setPixelRatio(1);
    composer.setSize(w, h);
    composer.addPass(new RenderPass(scene, camera));
    composer.addPass(new ShaderPass(NanGuardShader));
    const gtao = new GTAOPass(scene, camera, w, h);
    gtao.blendIntensity = 1.0;
    gtao.updateGtaoMaterial({ radius: 0.35, distanceExponent: 1.6, thickness: 0.6, scale: 1.0, samples: 16, distanceFallOff: 1.0, screenSpaceRadius: false });
    gtao.updatePdMaterial({ lumaPhi: 10, depthPhi: 2, normalPhi: 3, radius: 5, rings: 2, samples: 16 });
    composer.addPass(withoutFx(gtao, camera));
    const dof = withoutFx(new BokehPass(scene, camera, { focus: 3, aperture: 0.002, maxblur: 0.008 }), camera);
    composer.addPass(dof);
    const bloom = new UnrealBloomPass(new Vector2(w, h), 0.25, 0.5, 0.85);
    composer.addPass(bloom);
    composer.addPass(new OutputPass());
    const g = new ShaderPass(GradeShader);
    g.uniforms.uRes.value.set(w, h);
    composer.addPass(g);
    return { composer, dof, bloom, gtao, g };
  }, [gl, scene, camera, size.width, size.height]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    gl.toneMapping = NeutralToneMapping;
    gl.toneMappingExposure = grade.exposure;
    const u = chain.dof.uniforms as unknown as Record<string, { value: number }>;
    const dist = new Vector3(...cam.pos).distanceTo(new Vector3(...cam.target));
    u.focus.value = cam.focus ?? dist;
    u.aperture.value = cam.aperture ?? 0;
    u.maxblur.value = cam.maxBlur ?? 0;
    chain.dof.enabled = (cam.aperture ?? 0) > 0 && (cam.maxBlur ?? 0) > 0;
    chain.bloom.strength = grade.bloom;
    chain.bloom.radius = grade.bloomRadius;
    chain.bloom.threshold = grade.bloomThreshold;
    chain.gtao.blendIntensity = grade.ao;
    chain.gtao.enabled = grade.ao > 0.01;
    const U = chain.g.uniforms;
    U.uTime.value = frame % 997;
    U.uLift.value.set(...grade.lift);
    U.uGain.value.set(...grade.gain);
    U.uSat.value = grade.sat;
    U.uContrast.value = grade.contrast;
    U.uVignette.value = grade.vignette;
    U.uGrain.value = grade.grain;
    U.uFlash.value = grade.flash;
    U.uFlashColor.value.set(grade.flashColor);
    U.uBlack.value = grade.black;
    U.uCA.value = grade.ca;
  }, [frame, chain, cam, grade, gl]);

  useFrame(() => {
    chain.composer.render();
  }, 1);
  return null;
};

const mixN = (a: number, b: number, k: number) => a + (b - a) * k;
export const mixGrade = (a: Grade, b: Grade, k: number): Grade => {
  if (k <= 0) return a;
  if (k >= 1) return b;
  const o = { ...a };
  for (const key of Object.keys(a) as (keyof Grade)[]) {
    const va = a[key], vb = b[key];
    if (typeof va === "number" && typeof vb === "number") (o as Record<string, unknown>)[key] = mixN(va, vb, k);
    else if (Array.isArray(va) && Array.isArray(vb)) (o as Record<string, unknown>)[key] = [0, 1, 2].map((i) => mixN(va[i], vb[i], k));
    else if (typeof va === "string" && typeof vb === "string") (o as Record<string, unknown>)[key] = mixC(va, vb, k);
  }
  return o;
};

==== 12408 project/src/cine/set/parts.tsx
// Set-building kit for any world: axis-aligned slabs, walls with openings, hinged doors, windows and a
// small furniture library (bed, desk, chair, oil lamp, shelf, wall clock). Geometry + materials cached.

import React from "react";
import { DoubleSide, type Material } from "three";
import { box, cyl, sphere, torus } from "../../kits/worldforge/geo.ts";
import { phys, plankTex, tileTex, weaveTex } from "../mats.ts";
import { ceilTex, concreteTex, doorTex, plasterTex } from "./tex.ts";
import type { V3 } from "../Lights.tsx";

export const MAT = {
  wall: (c = "#d3cdbb") => phys(`wall${c}`, { color: c, roughness: 0.92, map: plasterTex("up", [1, 1], 0.12) }),
  dado: (c = "#5d7a74") => phys(`dado${c}`, { color: c, roughness: 0.55, map: plasterTex("dado", [1, 1], 0.3), clearcoat: 0.15 }),
  trim: (c = "#3c4b47") => phys(`trim${c}`, { color: c, roughness: 0.5 }),
  ceil: (rep: [number, number]) => phys(`ceil${rep}`, { color: "#d9d9d4", roughness: 0.95, map: ceilTex(rep) }),
  tile: (rep: [number, number]) => phys(`tile${rep}`, { color: "#ffffff", map: tileTex(rep), roughness: 0.34, clearcoat: 0.18, clearcoatRoughness: 0.45 }),
  planks: (rep: [number, number], c = "#ffffff") => phys(`planks${rep}${c}`, { color: c, map: plankTex(rep), roughness: 0.7, clearcoat: 0.1 }),
  frame: (c = "#3a2416") => phys(`frame${c}`, { color: c, roughness: 0.5, clearcoat: 0.3 }),
  door: (key: string, base?: string) => phys(`door${key}`, { color: "#ffffff", map: doorTex(key, base), roughness: 0.42, clearcoat: 0.45, clearcoatRoughness: 0.3 }),
  chrome: () => phys("chrome", { color: "#c9ccd1", metalness: 1, roughness: 0.22 }),
  steel: () => phys("steel", { color: "#55585e", metalness: 0.8, roughness: 0.45 }),
  brass: () => phys("brass", { color: "#b8973f", metalness: 1, roughness: 0.3 }),
  concrete: (rep: [number, number]) => phys(`concrete${rep}`, { color: "#ffffff", map: concreteTex(rep), roughness: 0.95 }),
  plastic: (c: string) => phys(`plastic${c}`, { color: c, roughness: 0.45, clearcoat: 0.2 }),
  matte: (c: string, r = 0.85) => phys(`matte${c}${r}`, { color: c, roughness: r }),
  wood: (c = "#7a5636") => phys(`wood${c}`, { color: c, roughness: 0.62, clearcoat: 0.12 }),
  glass: () => phys("glassPane", { color: "#b9cbe0", roughness: 0.05, metalness: 0, transparent: true, opacity: 0.18, clearcoat: 1, side: DoubleSide, depthWrite: false }),
  fabric: (key: string, c: string, stripe?: string) => phys(`fabric${key}`, { color: "#ffffff", map: weaveTex(key, c, [4, 4], stripe), roughness: 0.9, sheen: 0.5, sheenColor: "#d8dcea" }),
};

/** Axis-aligned slab from min to max corner. */
export const Slab: React.FC<{ min: V3; max: V3; m: Material; r?: number; cast?: boolean; recv?: boolean }> = ({ min, max, m, r = 0.004, cast = true, recv = true }) => {
  const w = max[0] - min[0], h = max[1] - min[1], d = max[2] - min[2];
  if (w <= 0 || h <= 0 || d <= 0) return null;
  return (
    <mesh geometry={box(+w.toFixed(4), +h.toFixed(4), +d.toFixed(4), r, 1)} material={m} position={[(min[0] + max[0]) / 2, (min[1] + max[1]) / 2, (min[2] + max[2]) / 2]} castShadow={cast} receiveShadow={recv} />
  );
};

export type Hole = { a0: number; a1: number; y0: number; y1: number };

/**
 * A wall along an axis with rectangular openings, from floor y0 to y0 + top. `axis` "z": runs along z at
 * x = c; "x": runs along x at z = c. Optional dado band (1 m) in a second material on both faces.
 */
export const HoledWall: React.FC<{ axis: "x" | "z"; c: number; a0: number; a1: number; holes: Hole[]; t?: number; y0?: number; top?: number; m?: Material; dado?: Material | null }> = ({ axis, c, a0, a1, holes, t = 0.15, y0 = 0, top = 2.8, m, dado = null }) => {
  const lo = Math.min(a0, a1), hi = Math.max(a0, a1);
  const hs = [...holes].sort((p, q) => Math.min(p.a0, p.a1) - Math.min(q.a0, q.a1)).map((h) => ({ ...h, a0: Math.min(h.a0, h.a1), a1: Math.max(h.a0, h.a1) }));
  const pieces: Hole[] = [];
  let cur = lo;
  for (const h of hs) {
    if (h.a0 > cur) pieces.push({ a0: cur, a1: h.a0, y0: 0, y1: top });
    if (h.y0 > 0) pieces.push({ a0: h.a0, a1: h.a1, y0: 0, y1: h.y0 });
    if (h.y1 < top) pieces.push({ a0: h.a0, a1: h.a1, y0: h.y1, y1: top });
    cur = Math.max(cur, h.a1);
  }
  if (cur < hi) pieces.push({ a0: cur, a1: hi, y0: 0, y1: top });
  const W = m ?? MAT.wall();
  const out: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  pieces.forEach((p, i) => {
    const mk = (ya: number, yb: number, mm: Material, k: string, inset = 0) => {
      if (yb <= ya) return;
      const min: V3 = axis === "z" ? [c - t / 2 - inset, y0 + ya, p.a0] : [p.a0, y0 + ya, c - t / 2 - inset];
      const max: V3 = axis === "z" ? [c + t / 2 + inset, y0 + yb, p.a1] : [p.a1, y0 + yb, c + t / 2 + inset];
      out.push(<Slab key={`${i}${k}`} min={min} max={max} m={mm} />);
    };
    if (dado && p.y0 < 1) {
      mk(p.y0, Math.min(1, p.y1), dado, "d", 0.004);
      mk(Math.max(1, p.y0), p.y1, W, "u");
    } else mk(p.y0, p.y1, W, "u");
  });
  return <>{out}</>;
};

/** Hinged door leaf in an opening: `at` = floor centre of the opening, `axis` = the wall direction,
 *  `open` 0..1 (swings 100° toward `inside` = +1/−1 across the wall). */
export const Door: React.FC<{ at: V3; axis: "x" | "z"; w?: number; h?: number; open?: number; inside?: 1 | -1; leaf?: Material; frame?: Material }> = ({ at, axis, w = 0.86, h = 2.02, open = 0, inside = 1, leaf, frame }) => {
  const L = leaf ?? MAT.door("plain", "#5a3a24");
  const F = frame ?? MAT.frame();
  const rot = axis === "x" ? 0 : Math.PI / 2;
  return (
    <group position={at} rotation={[0, rot, 0]}>
      {/* frame (local: wall along x, thickness along z) */}
      <Slab min={[-w / 2 - 0.06, 0, -0.1]} max={[-w / 2, h + 0.06, 0.1]} m={F} />
      <Slab min={[w / 2, 0, -0.1]} max={[w / 2 + 0.06, h + 0.06, 0.1]} m={F} />
      <Slab min={[-w / 2 - 0.06, h, -0.1]} max={[w / 2 + 0.06, h + 0.06, 0.1]} m={F} />
      <group position={[-w / 2, 0, 0]} rotation={[0, -open * 1.75 * inside, 0]}>
        <Slab min={[0.005, 0.01, -0.02]} max={[w - 0.005, h - 0.005, 0.02]} m={L} r={0.006} />
        {[1, -1].map((s) => <mesh key={s} geometry={sphere(0.028, 12, 8)} material={MAT.brass()} position={[w - 0.09, 1.0, s * 0.04]} castShadow />)}
      </group>
    </group>
  );
};

/** Window in a wall opening: frame, cross bars, glass, sill. Local like Door (wall along x). */
export const Window: React.FC<{ at: V3; axis: "x" | "z"; w: number; h: number; frame?: Material; bars?: number }> = ({ at, axis, w, h, frame, bars = 2 }) => {
  const F = frame ?? MAT.frame("#e8e2d4");
  const rot = axis === "x" ? 0 : Math.PI / 2;
  return (
    <group position={at} rotation={[0, rot, 0]}>
      <Slab min={[-w / 2, 0, -0.05]} max={[w / 2, 0.05, 0.05]} m={F} />
      <Slab min={[-w / 2, h - 0.05, -0.05]} max={[w / 2, h, 0.05]} m={F} />
      <Slab min={[-w / 2, 0, -0.05]} max={[-w / 2 + 0.05, h, 0.05]} m={F} />
      <Slab min={[w / 2 - 0.05, 0, -0.05]} max={[w / 2, h, 0.05]} m={F} />
      {Array.from({ length: bars - 1 }, (_, i) => -w / 2 + (w * (i + 1)) / bars).map((x) => <Slab key={x} min={[x - 0.02, 0, -0.03]} max={[x + 0.02, h, 0.03]} m={F} />)}
      <Slab min={[-w / 2, h / 2 - 0.02, -0.03]} max={[w / 2, h / 2 + 0.02, 0.03]} m={F} />
      <mesh geometry={box(w - 0.08, h - 0.08, 0.004, 0)} material={MAT.glass()} position={[0, h / 2, 0]} />
      <Slab min={[-w / 2 - 0.05, -0.04, -0.14]} max={[w / 2 + 0.05, 0.0, 0.14]} m={F} />
    </group>
  );
};

/** Bed with mattress, pillow and a folded blanket; head at −x, local origin = floor centre. */

/** Table/desk: local origin = floor centre, top at `top`. */
export const Desk: React.FC<{ at: V3; yaw?: number; w?: number; d?: number; top?: number; wood?: string }> = ({ at, yaw = 0, w = 1.3, d = 0.62, top = 0.76, wood = "#7a5636" }) => {
  const m = MAT.wood(wood);
  return (
    <group position={at} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
      <Slab min={[-w / 2, top - 0.04, -d / 2]} max={[w / 2, top, d / 2]} m={m} />
      {[[-1, -1], [1, -1], [-1, 1], [1, 1]].map(([sx, sz], i) => <Slab key={i} min={[sx * (w / 2 - 0.05) - 0.025, 0, sz * (d / 2 - 0.05) - 0.025]} max={[sx * (w / 2 - 0.05) + 0.025, top - 0.04, sz * (d / 2 - 0.05) + 0.025]} m={m} />)}
      <Slab min={[-w / 2 + 0.05, top - 0.16, -d / 2 + 0.04]} max={[w / 2 - 0.05, top - 0.04, -d / 2 + 0.06]} m={m} />
    </group>
  );
};

/** Wooden chair; the seat faces +z in local space (sitter looks toward +z). */
export const Chair: React.FC<{ at: V3; yaw?: number; wood?: string }> = ({ at, yaw = 0, wood = "#6a4a2e" }) => {
  const m = MAT.wood(wood);
  return (
    <group position={at} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
      <Slab min={[-0.21, 0.43, -0.2]} max={[0.21, 0.46, 0.2]} m={m} />
      <Slab min={[-0.21, 0.46, -0.22]} max={[0.21, 0.92, -0.19]} m={m} />
      {[[-0.18, -0.18], [0.18, -0.18], [-0.18, 0.18], [0.18, 0.18]].map(([x, z], i) => <mesh key={i} geometry={box(0.03, 0.43, 0.03, 0.005)} material={m} position={[x, 0.215, z]} castShadow />)}
    </group>
  );
};

/** Hurricane oil lamp (glass chimney glows with `on`). */
export const OilLamp: React.FC<{ at: V3; on: number }> = ({ at, on }) => (
  <group position={at}>
    <mesh geometry={cyl(0.06, 0.075, 0.08, 18)} material={MAT.brass()} position={[0, 0.04, 0]} castShadow />
    <mesh geometry={sphere(0.05, 18, 12)} material={phys(`oilChimney${Math.round(on * 20)}`, { color: "#fff0d8", emissive: "#ffb257", emissiveIntensity: 0.1 + 1.1 * on, roughness: 0.15, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85 })} position={[0, 0.15, 0]} scale={[1, 1.5, 1]} />
    <mesh geometry={cyl(0.03, 0.04, 0.06, 14, true)} material={phys("oilTop", { color: "#2a2620", metalness: 0.6, roughness: 0.4, side: DoubleSide })} position={[0, 0.25, 0]} />
    <mesh geometry={torus(0.06, 0.004, 6, 20, Math.PI)} material={MAT.steel()} position={[0, 0.27, 0]} />
  </group>
);

/** Wall shelf with a few books and jars. Local: back against −z. */
export const Shelf: React.FC<{ at: V3; yaw?: number; w?: number }> = ({ at, yaw = 0, w = 1.0 }) => (
  <group position={at} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
    <Slab min={[-w / 2, 0, 0]} max={[w / 2, 0.03, 0.24]} m={MAT.wood("#5d4029")} />
    {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((k) => <mesh key={k} geometry={box(0.05, 0.2 + (k % 3) * 0.03, 0.17, 0.006)} material={MAT.matte(["#7a2f2f", "#2f4f7a", "#c9b27a", "#3d5e3a", "#5a3b6a"][k], 0.7)} position={[-w / 2 + 0.1 + k * 0.06, 0.13 + (k % 3) * 0.015, 0.12]} castShadow />)}
    <mesh geometry={cyl(0.05, 0.05, 0.14, 16)} material={phys("jar", { color: "#b9d0c4", roughness: 0.1, transparent: true, opacity: 0.5 })} position={[w / 2 - 0.15, 0.1, 0.12]} />
  </group>
);

/** Round wall clock (hands from `time` in hours). Local: face toward +z. */
export const WallClock: React.FC<{ at: V3; yaw?: number; time: number }> = ({ at, yaw = 0, time }) => {
  const h = ((time % 12) / 12) * Math.PI * 2, m = ((time % 1) * Math.PI * 2);
  return (
    <group position={at} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]}>
      <mesh geometry={cyl(0.16, 0.16, 0.04, 32)} material={MAT.wood("#3e2a1a")} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} castShadow />
      <mesh geometry={cyl(0.14, 0.14, 0.005, 32)} material={MAT.matte("#efe8d8", 0.6)} position={[0, 0, 0.022]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
      <mesh geometry={box(0.012, 0.08, 0.004, 0)} material={MAT.matte("#141414")} position={[Math.sin(h) * 0.04, Math.cos(h) * 0.04, 0.027]} rotation={[0, 0, -h]} />
      <mesh geometry={box(0.008, 0.12, 0.004, 0)} material={MAT.matte("#141414")} position={[Math.sin(m) * 0.06, Math.cos(m) * 0.06, 0.029]} rotation={[0, 0, -m]} />
    </group>
  );
};

==== 10769 project/src/cine/set/tex.ts
// Procedural set textures (drawn once, deterministic, no files): plaster, panel doors, breeze
// blocks, gypsum ceiling, concrete, LED clock, the phone screen states, poster.

import { canvasTex } from "../mats.ts";
import { mulberry32 } from "../../kits/worldforge/noise.ts";

/** Mottled wall paint with a little grime toward the bottom (grey, multiplied by the material colour). */
export const plasterTex = (key: string, rep: [number, number] = [1, 1], grime = 0.25) =>
  canvasTex(`plaster${key}`, 512, 512, (g, w, h) => {
    const r = mulberry32(31);
    g.fillStyle = "#e9e9e9";
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    for (let k = 0; k < 900; k++) {
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(${r() > 0.5 ? "255,255,255" : "90,90,90"},${0.015 + r() * 0.03})`;
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(r() * w, r() * h, 6 + r() * 40, 4 + r() * 24, r() * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }
    const gr = g.createLinearGradient(0, h * 0.55, 0, h);
    gr.addColorStop(0, "rgba(60,50,40,0)");
    gr.addColorStop(1, `rgba(60,50,40,${grime})`);
    g.fillStyle = gr;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    for (let k = 0; k < 40; k++) {
      g.strokeStyle = `rgba(70,60,50,${0.03 + r() * 0.05})`;
      g.lineWidth = 1 + r() * 2;
      const x = r() * w;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(x, h * (0.6 + r() * 0.3));
      g.lineTo(x + (r() - 0.5) * 6, h);
      g.stroke();
    }
  }, rep);

/** Varnished plywood panel door: vertical grain, four recessed panels, wear around the handle. */
export const doorTex = (key: string, base = "#5a3520") =>
  canvasTex(`door${key}`, 512, 1024, (g, w, h) => {
    const r = mulberry32(key.length * 13 + 7);
    g.fillStyle = base;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    for (let k = 0; k < 160; k++) {
      g.strokeStyle = `rgba(${r() > 0.6 ? "120,80,50" : "25,12,6"},${0.08 + r() * 0.14})`;
      g.lineWidth = 0.6 + r() * 2.2;
      const x = r() * w;
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(x, 0);
      g.bezierCurveTo(x + (r() - 0.5) * 30, h * 0.33, x + (r() - 0.5) * 30, h * 0.66, x + (r() - 0.5) * 16, h);
      g.stroke();
    }
    const panel = (x: number, y: number, pw: number, ph: number) => {
      g.strokeStyle = "rgba(15,8,4,0.7)";
      g.lineWidth = 7;
      g.strokeRect(x, y, pw, ph);
      g.strokeStyle = "rgba(160,110,70,0.25)";
      g.lineWidth = 3;
      g.strokeRect(x + 6, y + 6, pw - 12, ph - 12);
    };
    panel(60, 60, 170, 400); panel(282, 60, 170, 400);
    panel(60, 540, 170, 420); panel(282, 540, 170, 420);
    const gr = g.createRadialGradient(w * 0.9, h * 0.52, 0, w * 0.9, h * 0.52, 120);
    gr.addColorStop(0, "rgba(20,10,4,0.35)");
    gr.addColorStop(1, "rgba(20,10,4,0)");
    g.fillStyle = gr;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
  });

/** Plank door for the gudang (rougher, paint flaking). */
export const plankDoorTex = () =>
  canvasTex("plankdoor", 512, 1024, (g, w, h) => {
    const r = mulberry32(77);
    const n = 6;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      g.fillStyle = `hsl(${24 + r() * 8}, ${20 + r() * 10}%, ${16 + r() * 7}%)`;
      g.fillRect((i * w) / n, 0, w / n, h);
      for (let k = 0; k < 30; k++) {
        g.strokeStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${0.1 + r() * 0.2})`;
        g.lineWidth = 0.5 + r() * 2;
        const x = (i * w) / n + r() * (w / n);
        g.beginPath();
        g.moveTo(x, 0);
        g.lineTo(x + (r() - 0.5) * 10, h);
        g.stroke();
      }
      g.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)";
      g.fillRect((i * w) / n, 0, 4, h);
    }
    g.fillStyle = "rgba(40,24,14,0.9)";
    g.fillRect(0, h * 0.18, w, 40);
    g.fillRect(0, h * 0.78, w, 40);
  });

/** Breeze block (roster) pattern: white = solid, black = hole (used as alpha map). */
export const rosterTex = () =>
  canvasTex("roster", 512, 128, (g, w, h) => {
    g.fillStyle = "#fff";
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    g.fillStyle = "#000";
    const cell = 64;
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x += cell) {
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(x + cell / 2, h / 2, cell * 0.3, h * 0.36, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
      g.fillRect(x + cell * 0.12, h * 0.12, cell * 0.12, h * 0.76);
      g.fillRect(x + cell * 0.76, h * 0.12, cell * 0.12, h * 0.76);
    }
  }, undefined, false);

/** Gypsum ceiling boards with seams. */
export const ceilTex = (rep: [number, number]) =>

export const concreteTex = (rep: [number, number]) =>
  canvasTex(`concrete${rep}`, 512, 512, (g, w, h) => {
    const r = mulberry32(53);
    g.fillStyle = "#8c8a86";
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    for (let k = 0; k < 3000; k++) {
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(${r() > 0.5 ? "255,255,255" : "0,0,0"},${0.02 + r() * 0.05})`;
      g.fillRect(r() * w, r() * h, 1 + r() * 4, 1 + r() * 4);
    }
    for (let k = 0; k < 12; k++) {
      g.strokeStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${0.08 + r() * 0.1})`;
      g.lineWidth = 1;
      g.beginPath();
      let x = r() * w, y = r() * h;
      g.moveTo(x, y);
      for (let s = 0; s < 8; s++) { x += (r() - 0.5) * 60; y += (r() - 0.5) * 60; g.lineTo(x, y); }
      g.stroke();
    }
  }, rep);

/** 7-segment LED digits (red), e.g. "02:17"; `colon` toggles the blinking colon. */
export const ledTex = (text: string, colon: boolean) =>
  canvasTex(`led${text}${colon}`, 512, 192, (g, w, h) => {
    g.fillStyle = "#000";
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    const SEG: Record<string, string> = { "0": "abcdef", "1": "bc", "2": "abged", "3": "abgcd", "4": "fgbc", "5": "afgcd", "6": "afgedc", "7": "abc", "8": "abcdefg", "9": "abcfgd" };
    const digit = (x: number, ch: string) => {
      const on = SEG[ch] ?? "";
      const sw = 70, sh = 130, t = 13, y = 30;
      const seg = (id: string, x0: number, y0: number, ww: number, hh: number) => {
        g.fillStyle = on.includes(id) ? "#ff3b2a" : "rgba(255,40,20,0.07)";
        g.beginPath();
        g.roundRect(x0, y0, ww, hh, 5);
        g.fill();
      };
      seg("a", x + t, y, sw - 2 * t, t);
      seg("g", x + t, y + sh / 2 - t / 2, sw - 2 * t, t);
      seg("d", x + t, y + sh - t, sw - 2 * t, t);
      seg("f", x, y + t, t, sh / 2 - t);
      seg("b", x + sw - t, y + t, t, sh / 2 - t);
      seg("e", x, y + sh / 2, t, sh / 2 - t);
      seg("c", x + sw - t, y + sh / 2, t, sh / 2 - t);
    };
    const chars = text.replace(":", "");
    const xs = [40, 135, 270, 365];
    chars.split("").forEach((c, i) => digit(xs[i], c));
    g.fillStyle = colon ? "#ff3b2a" : "rgba(255,40,20,0.07)";
    g.beginPath(); g.arc(236, 70, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();
    g.beginPath(); g.arc(236, 126, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill();
  }, undefined, true);

export type PhoneState = "off" | "notif";
export type PhoneMsg = { from?: string; text?: string; time?: string; date?: string };
/** Phone screen: lock screen with one notification (sender + up to two lines). Readable in an insert. */
export const phoneScreenTex = (state: PhoneState, msg: PhoneMsg = {}) =>
  canvasTex(`phone${state}${JSON.stringify(msg)}`, 720, 1440, (g, w, h) => {
    if (state === "off") {
      g.fillStyle = "#000";
      g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      return;
    }
    const gr = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, w, h);
    gr.addColorStop(0, "#1a2b4a");
    gr.addColorStop(0.55, "#0e1830");
    gr.addColorStop(1, "#24183a");
    g.fillStyle = gr;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    // soft wallpaper shapes
    for (const [x, y, rr, c] of [[180, 420, 260, "rgba(80,120,200,0.18)"], [560, 980, 320, "rgba(120,80,180,0.14)"]] as const) {
      const rg = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, rr);
      rg.addColorStop(0, c);
      rg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
      g.fillStyle = rg;
      g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    }
    g.fillStyle = "#eaf2ff";
    g.textAlign = "center";
    g.font = "500 38px Manrope, sans-serif";
    g.fillText(msg.date ?? "Sabtu, 8 Maret", w / 2, 200);
    g.font = "300 190px Manrope, sans-serif";
    g.fillText(msg.time ?? "23.47", w / 2, 390);
    // notification card
    const x = 40, y = 520, cw = w - 80, ch = 270;
    g.fillStyle = "rgba(235,240,250,0.9)";
    g.beginPath();
    g.roundRect(x, y, cw, ch, 44);
    g.fill();
    g.fillStyle = "#2f8f63";
    g.beginPath();
    g.roundRect(x + 34, y + 34, 76, 76, 20);
    g.fill();
    g.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(x + 72, y + 68, 22, 18, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    g.fill();
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(x + 58, y + 80); g.lineTo(x + 52, y + 94); g.lineTo(x + 70, y + 84); g.fill();
    g.textAlign = "left";
    g.fillStyle = "#11151d";
    g.font = "700 44px Manrope, sans-serif";
    g.fillText(msg.from ?? "Pesan baru", x + 134, y + 70);
    g.fillStyle = "#59606c";
    g.font = "500 30px Manrope, sans-serif";
    g.textAlign = "right";
    g.fillText("sekarang", x + cw - 36, y + 68);
    g.textAlign = "left";
    g.fillStyle = "#1b2029";
    g.font = "500 38px Manrope, sans-serif";
    // wrap the message into two lines
    const words = (msg.text ?? "Kamu sudah sampai?").split(" ");
    const lines = [""];
    for (const wd of words) { const tryL = (lines[lines.length - 1] + " " + wd).trim(); if (g.measureText(tryL).width > cw - 72 && lines.length < 2) lines.push(wd); else lines[lines.length - 1] = tryL; }
    lines.forEach((l, i) => g.fillText(l, x + 36, y + 170 + i * 52));
    g.fillStyle = "rgba(234,242,255,0.75)";
    g.font = "500 30px Manrope, sans-serif";
    g.textAlign = "center";
    g.fillText("Geser ke atas untuk membuka", w / 2, h - 90);
  });

==== 2328 project/src/cine/Stage.tsx
// CINÉSTORY stage: waits for the bundled font, mounts a Remotion-synchronised ThreeCanvas (PCF shadows,
// dpr 1, MSAA in the post chain) and lays the 2D overlay on top — designed at 1080 × 1920 for portrait
// (the default) or 1920 × 1080 for landscape, scaled to the render size. Everything inside must be a pure
// function of the frame.

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { AbsoluteFill, continueRender, delayRender, useVideoConfig } from "remotion";
import { ThreeCanvas } from "@remotion/three";
import { PCFShadowMap } from "three";
import { fontReady } from "../core/type/fonts.ts";

/** overlay design space per orientation */
export const designOf = (width: number, height: number) => (height > width ? { W: 1080, H: 1920 } : { W: 1920, H: 1080 });

/** Draft (fast look checks) and final (delivery) presets per format. */
export const PRESETS = {
  portrait: { draft: { width: 540, height: 960, fps: 30 }, final: { width: 1080, height: 1920, fps: 60 } },
  landscape: { draft: { width: 960, height: 540, fps: 30 }, final: { width: 1920, height: 1080, fps: 60 } },
} as const;

export const Stage: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode; overlay?: () => React.ReactNode }> = ({ children, overlay }) => {
  const { width, height } = useVideoConfig();
  const { W, H } = designOf(width, height);
  const [handle] = useState(() => delayRender("font"));
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    fontReady().then(() => {
      setReady(true);
      continueRender(handle);
    });
  }, [handle]);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ backgroundColor: "#000" }}>
      {ready ? (
        <>
          <ThreeCanvas
            width={width}
            height={height}
            shadows={{ type: PCFShadowMap }}
            dpr={1}
            gl={{ antialias: false, preserveDrawingBuffer: true, powerPreference: "high-performance" }}
            camera={{ fov: 30, near: 0.05, far: 400, position: [0, 1.6, 4] }}
          >
            {children}
          </ThreeCanvas>
          {overlay ? (
            <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, top: 0, width: W, height: H, transform: `scale(${width / W})`, transformOrigin: "0 0" }}>
              {overlay()}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </>
      ) : null}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

==== 1824 project/src/cine/types.ts
// Plain data types + constants shared by the picture (TSX) and Node scripts (director, sound): light rig
// state, camera, grade. No React / WebGL imports here, so Node's type stripping can load it.

export type V3 = [number, number, number];
export type PointL = { pos: V3; color: string; i: number; dist: number };
export type SpotL = { pos: V3; target: V3; color: string; i: number; angle: number; penumbra: number; dist: number };
export type LightState = {
  bg: string;
  fog: { color: string; density: number };
  env: number;
  hemi: { sky: string; ground: string; i: number };
  moon: { dir: V3; color: string; i: number; box: { min: V3; max: V3 } };
  spots: [SpotL, SpotL];
  pts: [PointL, PointL, PointL, PointL, PointL, PointL];
};

export const P_OFF: PointL = { pos: [0, -50, 0], color: "#ffffff", i: 0, dist: 1 };
export const S_OFF: SpotL = { pos: [0, 40, 0], target: [0, 0, 0], color: "#ffffff", i: 0, angle: 0.6, penumbra: 0.6, dist: 10 };

export type Cam = { pos: V3; target: V3; fov: number; roll?: number; focus?: number; aperture?: number; maxBlur?: number; near?: number; far?: number };

export type Grade = {
  exposure: number;
  /** additive lift in the shadows, multiplicative gain */
  lift: V3; gain: V3;
  sat: number; contrast: number;
  vignette: number; grain: number;
  bloom: number; bloomRadius: number; bloomThreshold: number;
  /** 0..1 flash toward `flashColor`, 0..1 fade to black */
  flash: number; flashColor: string; black: number;
  ao: number;
  /** lens chromatic fringe at the frame edge (0 = off) */
  ca: number;
};

export const GRADE0: Grade = {
  exposure: 1, lift: [0, 0, 0], gain: [1, 1, 1], sat: 1, contrast: 1, vignette: 0.22, grain: 0.016,
  bloom: 0.22, bloomRadius: 0.45, bloomThreshold: 1.05, flash: 0, flashColor: "#ffffff", black: 0, ao: 1, ca: 0.0012,
};


==== 19126 project/src/cine/ui.tsx
// CINÉSTORY motion-graphics kit (2D overlay: 1080×1920 portrait or 1920×1080 landscape; sizes and positions come from the layout in film/Overlay.tsx). Every element is driven by an appear amount
// `a` (0..1) and/or a progress value, so shots animate them as pure functions of time. Readable,
// documentary style: Manrope, thin rules, glass cards, cyan = information, amber = interpretation.

import React from "react";

export const CYAN = "#8fdcff";
export const AMBER = "#ffbf73";
export const RED = "#ff6b5e";
export const INK = "#eef3fb";
const FONT = "Manrope, sans-serif";
const clamp = (x: number) => Math.min(1, Math.max(0, x));
const eo = (x: number) => 1 - (1 - clamp(x)) ** 3;
/** appear amount for an element living in [t0, t1] with fades. */
export const span = (v: number, t0: number, t1: number, fin = 0.45, fout = 0.4) => eo((v - t0) / fin) * (1 - clamp((v - (t1 - fout)) / fout));

const abs = (x: number, y: number): React.CSSProperties => ({ position: "absolute", left: x, top: y });

/** Chip label: small caps text in a thin-bordered glass box. */
export const Tag: React.FC<{ x: number; y: number; a: number; text: string; sub?: string; color?: string; size?: number; anchor?: "l" | "c" | "r" }> = ({ x, y, a, text, sub, color = CYAN, size = 26, anchor = "l" }) =>
  a <= 0.001 ? null : (
    <div style={{ ...abs(x, y), transform: `translate(${anchor === "c" ? "-50%" : anchor === "r" ? "-100%" : "0"}, -50%) translateY(${(1 - a) * 14}px)`, opacity: a, fontFamily: FONT }}>
      <div style={{ padding: "10px 18px", border: `1.5px solid ${color}`, background: "rgba(8,14,26,0.55)", backdropFilter: "blur(6px)", borderRadius: 6, color: INK, whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: size, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: "0.08em", color }}>{text}</div>
        {sub ? <div style={{ fontSize: size * 0.72, fontWeight: 400, marginTop: 4, color: INK, opacity: 0.9 }}>{sub}</div> : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

/** Callout: a dot on a projected 3D point, a leader line, and a label. */
export const Callout: React.FC<{ p: { x: number; y: number; z?: number }; a: number; text: string; sub?: string; dx?: number; dy?: number; color?: string; W?: number; H?: number; size?: number }> = ({ p, a, text, sub, dx = 160, dy = -90, color = CYAN, W = 1920, H = 1080, size = 26 }) => {
  if (a <= 0.001 || (p.z !== undefined && p.z <= 0)) return null;
  const lx = p.x + dx * eo(a * 1.4), ly = p.y + dy * eo(a * 1.4);
  return (
    <>
      <svg width={W} height={H} style={abs(0, 0)}>
        <circle cx={p.x} cy={p.y} r={7 * a} fill="none" stroke={color} strokeWidth={2} opacity={a} />
        <circle cx={p.x} cy={p.y} r={2.5} fill={color} opacity={a} />
        <line x1={p.x} y1={p.y} x2={lx} y2={ly} stroke={color} strokeWidth={1.5} opacity={a * 0.9} />
      </svg>
      <Tag x={lx + (dx >= 0 ? 8 : -8)} y={ly} a={clamp(a * 1.6 - 0.4)} text={text} sub={sub} color={color} anchor={dx >= 0 ? "l" : "r"} size={size} />
    </>
  );
};

/** Big centred title (section headings, key terms). */
export const Title: React.FC<{ a: number; text: string; sub?: string; kicker?: string; y?: number; size?: number; color?: string; maxWidth?: number; left?: number; right?: number }> = ({ a, text, sub, kicker, y = 540, size = 84, color = INK, maxWidth, left = 0, right = 0 }) =>
  a <= 0.001 ? null : (
    <div style={{ position: "absolute", left, right, top: y, transform: "translateY(-50%)", textAlign: "center", fontFamily: FONT, color, opacity: a }}>
      {kicker ? <div style={{ fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 600, letterSpacing: "0.5em", color: CYAN, marginBottom: 18, paddingLeft: "0.5em" }}>{kicker}</div> : null}
      <div style={{ fontSize: size, fontWeight: 300, letterSpacing: `${0.22 + 0.08 * (1 - a)}em`, paddingLeft: "0.22em", whiteSpace: maxWidth ? "normal" : "nowrap", maxWidth, margin: maxWidth ? "0 auto" : undefined, lineHeight: 1.15, textShadow: `${EDGE}, 0 2px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.45)` }}>{text}</div>
      {sub ? <div style={{ fontSize: 30, fontWeight: 400, marginTop: 22, opacity: 0.88, textShadow: EDGE }}>{sub}</div> : null}
    </div>
  );

// light text that must read on any picture (a white floor, a bright sky) carries a dark edge or sits on glass
const EDGE = "0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 2px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.55)";

/** Lower-third statement (left, above the letterbox), on a glass plate. */
export const Lower: React.FC<{ a: number; text: string; sub?: string; color?: string; y?: number; x?: number; size?: number; maxWidth?: number }> = ({ a, text, sub, color = CYAN, y = 860, x = 120, size = 40, maxWidth }) =>

    <div style={{ ...abs(x, y), maxWidth, transform: `translateY(-100%) translateX(${(1 - a) * -20}px)`, opacity: a, fontFamily: FONT, color: INK, padding: "16px 22px 18px", background: "rgba(8,14,26,0.55)", backdropFilter: "blur(6px)", borderRadius: 10, boxSizing: "border-box" }}>
      <div style={{ width: 70 * a, height: 3, background: color, marginBottom: 14 }} />

    </div>
  );

/** Rubber stamp (✓/✗ verdicts). */

  );

/** Glass card. */
export const Card: React.FC<{ x: number; y: number; w: number; h?: number; a: number; children: React.ReactNode; color?: string }> = ({ x, y, w, h, a, children, color = "rgba(143,220,255,0.55)" }) =>
